scope: Trusted phase-accounting request, receipt intake, read projection and polling observer. All controls use invented metadata in temporary private SQLite files.

findings.originalBehavior: A receipt containing cumulative USD 0.039999999999999999 was accepted against an observed 0.04 lower bound because Number conversion rounded both to the same value.
findings.independentReproduction: The original copied source failed the exact-decimal rejection assertion before any source update.
findings.fix: Root compares exact receipt atoms against an exact interpretation of the numeric lower bound's decimal serialization, including exponent notation and upward rounding below receipt precision.
findings.finalControls: The original intake control passes; additional tests cover 1e-7 and 1e-19 bounds and the read-projection completeness check before microdollar rounding.

findings.originalBehavior: After runtime polling began, mutation of the caller-owned request's phase redirected a later poll to an already-complete adjudication receipt.
findings.independentReproduction: The original copied source resolved instead of rejecting on cancellation in the independent mutable-request control.
findings.fix: Root parses a private deep copy of the request once before the observer's first await.
findings.finalControls: The same caller mutation cannot redirect polling; the observer keeps waiting for its original runtime phase and rejects on cancellation.

verification.purpose: Independent reproduction of the two reported defects.

verification.source: isolated checkout with fixed metadata module

additionalControls: Absent receipts remain null and incomplete even for an empty recorded inventory.
Cumulative revisions replace totals rather than being added; old duplicate acceptance returns the current head without moving it backward.
A stale second connection cannot replace an accepted compare-and-swap head.
Changed same-ID bodies, noncontiguous revisions, wrong previous digests and stale expected heads reject.
Recorded source, plan, model, policy, dispatch, reservation, phase, mode, cap, stage, checkpoint and operation coverage cannot be replaced by a self-consistent receipt/context pair.
Live null model locks, duplicate handles, changed final requests and unsupported whole-episode scope reject.
Unknown currency, non-USD units, unsupported estimated fields and missing evidence cannot establish complete measured USD.
Unresolved inventory, incomplete cleanup and continuing retention preserve incompleteness and polling remains cancellable.
Known cumulative USD and CPU cannot decrease or become unknown in later accepted revisions.
Expired, predating and future-issued observations cannot authorize current completeness; historical numeric values remain lower bounds.
Runtime and adjudication are separate cumulative domains; the store never adds them together.
Read-only reopen exposes accepted history without allowing intake or request creation.
Returned data and later caller mutations do not change stored request or receipt bindings.
Missing read-only files, symlinks, hardlinks, broad permissions and corrupted stored receipt bodies reject.
limitations: This review did not inspect or execute provider, repair, candidate or sealed evaluation code.
No actual provider receipt, USD unit, CPU metric, cleanup state, retention finality or external receipt authenticity was verified.

The module intentionally performs no ledger reconciliation or dispatch writes; live prospective budgets, terminal-state protection and exactly-once combination of runtime plus adjudication remain caller integration responsibilities.
Accepted-digest context is independently trusted input; hashes alone do not authenticate measurements.
The store is private trusted metadata infrastructure, not isolation against a privileged same-UID adversary or coordinated rollback of all durable state.
Private experiment-session and phase-accounting CLI reviews are outside this receipt's scope.
